Congrats!
We're glad you're here
Hi {!Contact.FirstName} {!Contact.LastName},
Welcome to Monster. We hope you and your loved ones are safe and healthy in these uncertain times.
Congrats on your first step! You now have the most powerful tool in recruiting.
Monster's cutting-edge hiring solutions help you find the most relevant candidates -
fast!
I am {!User.Name}, from the Customer Relations team and I'll be happy to help you.
Let's get started!

Escalation of any Customer Service matter
In the unlikely event of your query or complaint not being resolved promptly to your satisfaction, please write a mail to crhead@monsterindia.com as a first level of escalation and to ceo@monsterindia.com for second level escalation. The
matter will be directly investigated by the senior management of our Customer Service team.
Terms of Use We thank you for using Monster. For uninterrupted access to our services, it is important for you to read and understand our Terms of Use. For your convenience, we are emphasizing on some of the Prohibited Uses of Monster listed and we look forward to your cooperation in adhering to the same.
In view of our experience of Clients' request for the inclusion of their jobs on Monster Platform for better visibility, outreach
and result, we are enabling job scrapping / job replication feature as default for select customers including your
organization. Please note, jobs that are scrapped from your career site will not be consuming inventory that you have purchased.
